page.overview:
What is Mutiny in the Atoan system?

In 19 BBY, a mutiny took place aboard Darth Vader's Imperial I-class Star Destroyer in the Atoan system, between Imperial loyal forces of the 501st Legion, led by Darth Vader, and Captain Shale's traitorous storm commandos.
